title: Normal mode

{{term-stub}}
[[Normal mode]] is the default mode of play for ''[[Guild Wars]]''. It was dubbed "normal mode" with the introduction of [[hard mode]] in the [[Game updates/20070419|April 19th, 2007 update]]. Normal mode is the regular gameplay mode of the game with [[non-player character|NPCs']] [[level]]s being progressively raised from beginning to end.

After hard mode was introduced, normal mode was made slightly easier and later updates made it so that [[foe]]s would respond more slowly to [[Area of Effect]] skills.

==Limitations in normal mode==
In comparison to hard mode, aside from weaker NPCs, the rewards for completing missions are lower. Likewise, some [[title]]s, or just certain ranks in titles, are unobtainable in normal mode.
*[[Sunspear rank|Sunspear]], [[Asura rank|Asura]], [[Deldrimor rank|Deldrimor]], [[Ebon Vanguard rank|Ebon Vanguard]], and [[Norn rank]]s can only be obtained up to rank eight.
*[[Vanquisher]] and [[Guardian]] titles cannot be obtained; as such, neither can [[Legendary Vanquisher]] nor [[Legendary Guardian]].
*You can only gain 335 points, or rank 2, in [[Master of the North]].

As such, by only doing normal mode, players can only [[Kind of a Big Deal|max]] 16 [[Player versus Environment|PvE]] titles, not including [[Legendary Defender of Ascalon]] or [[account]] titles.

== Trivia ==
* Hard mode was introduced in the [[Game updates/20070419|April 19, 2007 update]] for ''Prophecies'', ''Factions'', and ''Nightfall'' and in the [[Game updates/20071012|October 12, 2007 update]] for ''Eye of the North''.
* Hard mode foes' armor rating was reduced and their [[Level#Effects of level|maximum health]] was raised in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20120105|January 5, 2012 update]].
